mapper.select: SELECT cri.change_req_id, cri.change_description, cri.status, cri.change_req_date, cri.change_start_time, cri.business_type, hbm.bp_name, con.contract_id, con.contract_number, con.contract_name, con.prepayment_method, ( select scvb.meaning from sys_code_b scb,sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scb.code = 'FCT.PREPAYMENT_METHOD' and scvb.value = con.prepayment_method ) as prepayment_method_desc, (select ref_pp.ref_project_id from prj_project ref_pp where ref_pp.project_id=(select ppt.ref_project_id from prj_project ppt where ppt.project_id=con.project_id))change_original_project_id, (select ref_pp.credit_line_id from prj_project ref_pp where ref_pp.project_id=con.project_id)credit_line_id, (select user_name from sys_user su where su.user_id=cri.CREATED_BY)created_by_desc FROM con_contract con, change_req_info cri, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE con.contract_id = #{documentId} AND cri.change_req_id=con.change_req_id AND hbm.bp_id=con.tenant_id

SELECT (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'BP' ) AS bp_count, (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'CF' ) AS cf_count, (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'PA' ) AS pa_count, (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'CC' ) AS cc_count, (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'IF' ) AS if_count, (select COUNT(*) from change_req_info cri where cri.business_type = 'PP' ) AS pp_count from dual

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM change_req_info cri WHERE cri.business_type = 'BEFORELAUNCH' ) AS BEFORELAUNCH_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM change_req_info cri WHERE cri.business_type = 'CONTRACTTEXT' ) AS CONTRACTTEXT_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM change_req_info cri WHERE cri.business_type = 'AFTERLAUNCH' ) AS AFTERLAUNCH_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM change_req_info cri WHERE cri.business_type = 'BACKMONEYACCOUNT' ) AS BACKMONEYACCOUNT_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM change_req_info cri WHERE cri.business_type = 'PREREPAYMENT' ) AS PREREPAYMENT_COUNT FROM DUAL
select * from change_req_info where change_req_id=( select MAX(change_req_id) from prj_project where project_number=(select project_number from prj_project where project_id=#{documentId}))
select * from change_req_info c where c.document_category = #{documentCategory} and c.document_id = #{documentId} and c.status in ('NEW','APPROVING')

select c.*, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = c.meet_flag) meet_flag_n from change_req_info c where c.change_req_id = #{changeReqId}

select c.*, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = c.meet_flag) meet_flag_n from change_req_info c where c.change_req_id = #{changeReqId}
